Leash checks, a clear notice after lunch
We write to travelers

Travel Notice for Companion Animals

Travelers need to keep pet papers, carrier checks, and feeding notes ready before arrival at the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways.

The welcome team will guide you through the first steps, and the passenger coordinator will confirm what must be shown before boarding. Please keep pets calm, secured, and close at hand while you move through the terminal. If a pet shows stress, tell staff at once so the matter can be handled with care and in order.

For travelers using the pet lounge, <<FACT F002>> Follow the posted use rules, keep the area tidy, and do not leave animals without supervision. A senior coordinator reviews daily service decisions, and any issue that needs further review will move through the normal calm process.

Keira Park and Sara Muller may ask for help with their pets, and Benny should remain on leash or in carrier as directed. Bring all items needed for comfort and safety, and keep travel papers within reach so the desk can work quickly.

For full assistance and final checks, please come to the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
